scenes.title: GapWitness: review missing environmental observations
scenes.caption: A focused review workflow for hourly environmental CSVs. Declare the reporting window, inspect the original bytes, and preserve reproducible evidence.

scenes.title: Inspect the declared window
scenes.caption: This frozen AirNow/OpenAQ derivative deliberately removes seven hours. It is a controlled example, with source provenance and no claim of a natural outage.

scenes.title: Review findings and revisions
scenes.caption: The reviewer sees exact missing timestamps and a reproducible decision record. Revision comparison distinguishes restored hours, deleted hours, and changed measurements.

scenes.title: Show how omissions change a summary
scenes.caption: Seven deliberately omitted source readings lower the available-reading mean from 3.2792 to 2.9882 micrograms per cubic metre, or 8.87%. This is a controlled arithmetic comparison, not an observed environmental outcome.

scenes.title: Keep original bytes and portable evidence
scenes.caption: Saving is explicit. The browser retains the original CSV and evidence package locally, then rechecks them on reopen. Retained source bytes make later review possible.

scenes.title: Verify the actual Sepolia witness
scenes.caption: This is a fresh public RPC check, without a wallet or mocked response. Verification checks the pinned runtime, publisher-scoped record, transaction calldata, receipt, and matching event.

scenes.title: Thirteen retained real-source windows
scenes.caption: Four stations and two providers extend the evaluation beyond edited fixtures. Source hashes, licenses, raw slices, and normalization are documented. Three windows have unavailable source readings.

scenes.title: Inspect a naturally unavailable reading window
scenes.caption: York Fishergate, April 2025, has two unavailable PM2.5 readings in the retained source. No numeric observations were deleted or edited. These findings do not establish fraud or misconduct.

scenes.title: Optional publishing from desktop or phone
scenes.caption: The Publish page supports browser wallets and on-demand MetaMask mobile or QR pairing. Connecting alone does not sign or publish. A wallet owner approves the testnet transaction separately.

scenes.title: Collect measured reviewer benefits
scenes.caption: The pilot starts with zero records. It times paired normal-method and GapWitness tasks, checks exact answers, and exports observed results. No independent adoption or time-saving benefit has yet been established.

scenes.title: Report actual operational protection
scenes.caption: The status page exposes actual quota mode and scoped instance measurements. Shared admission logic has a real cross-instance test; production activation still needs a protected persistent store.

scenes.title: Keep the proof boundaries visible
scenes.caption: V2 has exact source verification through Sourcify. Optional operator signatures require an independently established operator key. Sepolia evidence cannot prove sensor calibration, scientific truth, or environmental outcomes.

presentation: Actual deployed-app recording with burned-in English captions and loading waits trimmed. Silent, with no voice-over. No request mocks, synthetic pilot records, or new wallet transaction.
sceneTimeline: Raw capture timings. The rendered export trims loading waits while preserving each completed scene.
